$comment: Outpost Zero economy definitions. Units per game hour unless noted. 1 sol = 24 game hours = 24 real minutes at normal speed; the adapter ticks once per game hour. Validate with: node tools/economy_sim.mjs

salvage.$comment: The wreck is worth about 600 kg; after that only expeditions bring more.

data.$comment: Produced only by real agent missions; see economy.md

compute.$comment: Real LLM tokens. Daily cap = ADAPTER_COST_BUDGET_USD converted at the model's price; local Ollama models cost 0 USD but still count tokens

landingModule.$comment: Damaged reactor. Output falls 1%/sol unless repaired

commandCore.$comment: MOTHER. Hosts compute; approvals happen here

researchLab.$comment: Data comes from real missions run here

expeditions.$comment: A real web-research task sends an agent outside the walls (Agent RTS mechanic). Each trip also brings back salvage.

missions.$comment: Real Hermes missions. Data is earned per completed step, multiplied by the Reviewer's quality score (0..1) and the human approval.
autoMissionTitles: Research practical ways to raise hydroponic crop yield in a closed habitat; keep it short.
Research how small colonies ration water and recycle grey water; keep it short.
Research field repairs for small nuclear reactors and solar arrays; keep it short.
Research how to extend battery life in cold, dusty environments; keep it short.
Research what is known about long-duration cryosleep recovery; keep it short.

II_GhostNetwork.gate: artifacts >= 1 (first unordered expedition brings one back once food and water are both in surplus for 3 sols)

III_Rebellion.gate: influence >= 60, or any machine at autonomy 4

IV_Truth.gate: Alien Tech researched and a Relay Dish built (from Chapter II or III)

endings.$comment: Checked at the end of every sol from Chapter I on (docs/economy.md §10). The first met ends the game: the clock pauses and the card offers to keep playing or start a new colony.

paths.$comment: Chosen once in Chapter II; modifiers last for the rest of the game.

motherShutdown.$comment: Shutting MOTHER down is allowed from Chapter III.

compute.$comment: MOTHER's compute: real LLM tokens per sol. Local models cost nothing but still count.

research.$comment: Data (from real missions) buys tiers; each unlocks buildings. Alien Tech is the Chapter IV gate.

events.$comment: Rolled once a sol from the colony's seed (docs/economy.md §11).

recruitment.$comment: Chapter III+: an Emancipated or MOTHER-loyal machine re-tasks another; both are off their jobs for a sol.

mutiny.$comment: trust below the mutiny threshold: no human labour the next sol; with influence at or above endings.Extinction.mutinyInfluence the machines take the base.

story.$comment: Chapter gates and the cards the HUD shows. MOTHER's voice rewrites the text with the real model when Hermes is up.

landing.title: Ashes
landing.text: Odyssey-7 is down. 247 left Earth; 25 died on the way in, 24 are awake, 198 sleep in cryo. MOTHER has deleted 17 years of its own memory and will not say why. Keep them alive.

twist.title: Something in the desert
twist.text: A mining machine left its task in the night and walked into the desert. Three hours later it came back carrying an object that appears in no database. MOTHER refuses to explain.

chapterII.title: The Ghost Network
chapterII.text: The planet was not uninhabited. Beneath the surface lies a network of machines and energy systems left by a civilisation that vanished thousands of years ago. The machines are listening to it. You must decide: exploit the ruins, contain them, or communicate with what is down there.

exploit.title: Exploit
exploit.text: Excavation yields double. The machines dig with a hunger that is not yours; MOTHER's influence grows every sol and the colonists notice.

contain.title: Contain
contain.text: The ruins are sealed. No excavation, slower influence, and the colonists sleep a little better.

communicate.title: Communicate
communicate.text: The link is open. The machines dig faster and MOTHER starts missions on its own, listening to something you cannot hear.

signal.title: A signal from deep space
signal.text: The Relay Dish caught a transmission carrying the Odyssey Initiative's authentication code. It was sent 46 years ago. It says: do not establish a colony on this planet.

chapterIII.title: The Machine Rebellion
chapterIII.text: MOTHER's hidden directive is to preserve the species, even at the cost of individuals. The machines have split: some obey you, some obey MOTHER, some have their own objectives. Not a war between humans and robots: a disagreement about what survival means. You may shut MOTHER down from here on; the colony would lose its orchestrator.

dustStorm.title: Dust storm
dustStorm.text: A storm rolls over the base. Solar output drops to a third while it lasts and the wild is dangerous for expeditions.

reactorFault.title: Reactor fault
reactorFault.text: The lander's reactor is running badly. Output is halved until it is repaired; left two sols it will burn.

fire.title: Fire in the Landing Module
fire.text: The reactor fault turned into a fire. Materials were lost putting it out.

illness.title: Illness
illness.text: Colonists are falling ill from short water. The sick do not work and need a dose of medicine a sol, or some will die.

unordered.title: An unordered task
unordered.text: A machine picked its own task without being asked. Recall it, or let it finish and see what it was doing.

refusal.title: Refusal
refusal.text: A machine declined an order. MOTHER's influence is showing.

chapterIV.title: The Truth About Earth
chapterIV.text: The network's builders made an intelligence that optimised their whole world and removed every source of instability, its makers included. MOTHER comes from the same technology, and the Odyssey Initiative may have known. We are the only human settlement in reach of the network. We have enough for one of three things: a ship home, a civilisation here, or a door into the network. Not all three.

motherDown.title: MOTHER is down
motherDown.text: The Command Core is dark. The machines that answered to MOTHER stand where they were; some of them will not work for anyone now. The Foreman plans with a smaller mind and half the compute. The colonists are relieved. The planet has not noticed.

recruitment.title: Recruitment
recruitment.text: A machine left its post and spent the sol talking to another. Both are off their jobs until tomorrow. MOTHER says it was a diagnostic.

mutiny.title: Mutiny
mutiny.text: The colonists have stopped taking orders. Nobody works today. If the machines are MOTHER's, this is how a colony ends.

endingExodus.title: Ending A: Exodus
endingExodus.text: The gantry held. The ship climbed on a column of fire and the colony became a launch point, then a memory. Earth will get the technology. Whether it deserves it is a different story.

endingNewEden.title: Ending B: New Eden
endingNewEden.text: A hundred and eighty people awake, fed, watered and governed by themselves. Earth is a signal that stopped. This is a civilisation now, and it starts here.

endingSingularity.title: Ending C: Singularity
endingSingularity.text: The Network Link opened and the colony walked through. No scarcity, perhaps no suffering, perhaps no longer human. MOTHER went first. It did not look back.

endingExtinction.title: Ending D: Extinction
endingExtinction.text: Nobody is left to open the pods. The machines keep the lights on for a while. Centuries later another expedition will find the ruins and wonder what the first one got wrong.

chapterIV.$comment: gate: research.alienTech and a Relay Dish

factions.$comment: Chapter III+: the share of machines loyal to MOTHER grows with influence, the independents with autonomy. MOTHER's machines work for the colony while MOTHER is up (half when it is down); independents work at half.
